hookLine: Ranking the most disastrous wedding fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: Fishing the wedding ring out of the sink drain with tweezers.
Number 4: The best man taking an unexpected dive straight into the pond mid-ceremony.
Number 3: The entire wedding cake sliding off the table in one go.
Number 2: The bride getting dropped mid-lift on the dance floor.
Number 1: Throwing the bride straight into the pool, wedding dress and all!

outroLine: Congrats to the happy couple, subscribe!
